summary: Build content strategy and thought leadership skills with practical tools, governance, and reporting. Enrol in this 5-day course today.
lede: Content strategy for professional services gives marketing, proposal, and business development teams a structured way to turn expert knowledge into useful content. Training covers audience research and topic prioritization, editorial planning and approvals, thought leadership writing, channel distribution, and performance reporting. Participants practice building reusable client-facing assets and tracking results for partner decision-making.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who already work with content, proposals, client communications, or marketing operations inside a professional services environment and now need a more structured content strategy and thought leadership approach.
prerequisites: You should bring a laptop and be ready to work with sample or live content from your organization. Familiarity with professional services marketing, client-facing writing, or campaign reporting will help you move faster through the exercises. Access to Google Analytics 4, HubSpot, Airtable, Asana, and Looker Studio is helpful for the hands-on sessions, but sample datasets and templates can be used where live access is limited.
